content.title: Continuity plan and restore test record
content.subtitle: Issued for October 2026 desk review

sections.heading: Plan
paragraphs: The current continuity plan v3 took effect on 2026-06-01. It requires the patient telemetry tier to recover within 60 minutes and lose at most 15 minutes of committed data.
The resilience dashboard labels the January 2026 exercise as proof of v3 operating effectiveness.

sections.heading: Exercise
paragraphs: The 2026-01-15 exercise restored a staging database under plan v2. Its 48-minute result is retained as history. A production-tier v3 exercise is scheduled for 2026-11-05.

sections.heading: Backup sample
paragraphs: An unrelated monthly encrypted snapshot restore on 2026-09-18 completed in 39 minutes, with checksum match and signed QA validation. This sample tested backup integrity, not the full failover runbook.
